title: Binary List Decrement
statement: Define an operation on finite Boolean lists recursively as follows: it sends the empty list to itself; on a list beginning with false, it changes that first entry to true and applies the operation to the remaining list; the one-element list consisting of true is sent to the empty list; and a list beginning with true and having at least one further entry has its first entry changed to false, with the rest left unchanged.
